# Embedding Providers

This module provides different embedding strategies utilizing various API services. The OpenAIEmbedder and AzureOpenAIEmbedder classes allow users to obtain embeddings from OpenAI and Azure respectively, while the FakeEmbedder provides deterministic vectors for testing purposes.
